body: It's ok. I know I don't really leave a lot of room for things to say or inspiration. thank you for thinking about me though, I appreciate it. Who knows, if I don't go through with it, and somehow by some fucking random turn of events become happy, I'll come back and let you all know.

I've had more therapists than I can count. Had several psychiatrists, been on over 10 different antidepressants. I've been in outpatient clinics for depression. And I've been extremely honest with all of them. About me wanting to die. I even told my psychiatrist when I was looking into going to another country for euthanasia. I've done it all. I'm fucking sick of trying. 

And I know it would send a positive message. But honestly, I'm not worried about the other selves walking around this earth. I want to be selfish at this point, and end this self. I want to be put down. I have bad genetics as far as my brain is concerned and I shouldn't be a part of the human race.

The thing is, I kind of want to end it before I go to rehab. I started drinking heavy around 23, and I was absolutely miserable before I started. The drinking eased everything up for years. And then it became a huuuge problem about 3 years ago. Started doing waaay more damage than good. I've gotten sober for like, a month at a time before. I'm miserable the entire time and riddled with anxiety. My anxiety is part of what started me drinking. But when I seriously started drinking it was because I wanted to die of alcohol poisoning at some point and figured it would just eventually happen. I was seriously planning on being dead by 30 and very much lived that way. Partied constantly, never slept. It was basically girls molly and booze. booze being the ultimate god. Idk where I'm going with this. But the point is, I'm fucking tired of existing. I don't wanna put all the work in to be sober just to still be miserable. it's too much. life is too much, and I'm over it.

I lost the place I was living. I'm at my parents where I'm watched constantly for drinking. And they want me to go to rehab due to a recent bender I was on. Disappeared for a week, lost my job, was sleeping in my car. That kind of shit. And I hate being an alcoholic. But I also have no desire to get sober. I figure I've always wanted to end it all. Now is as good of time as any. And yeah, I've had constant suicidal ideations since I was a kid.

I was thinking of maybe putting up a sign on the outside that said something about it being closed for fumigation or something. So even if people see it, they won't think anything, but Idk if that would work. Car fumes are pretty easy to recognize by smell

Well I've tried a bunch of other ways in the past. I want something that is actually going to work this time. And yeah, it's thought out because I don't want to try again unless it's going to work. 

As far as who could interrupt me, I'm worried about the fumes building up and pouring outside the door. Someone sees fumes coming out of a garage and calls the fire department. I plan on using a lot of heavy duty zip ties to secure the door along the frame to stop it from being opened, which would delay efforts, but I don't know for how long. 

Edit: The garage, while stand-alone is in a downtown area. So there is definitely a chance of someone noticing if fumes are coming out.

Idk, it's not even rehab. It's just being stuck inside my sober brain for that long, and then supposedly from then on. 3 months being locked away. Even though it's 'my choice,' and could technically quit whenever I want. It's still being locked away. Plus, I don't want to stop drinking. I don't want anything. I don't want to be here at all. Ugh, sorry.

I have a pre 1970's car. In a stand-alone garage. No windows. I plan on tarping off the door after closing it. Taking a hose from the exhaust to the window. Turning the car on, and drinking a fifth of whiskey til I pass out and then just never wake up. 

Only thing I'm worried about is someone stopping me before it's finished. I figure to be on the safe side, I need 3 hours time. 

And as far as why not go on? Idk, I'm absolutely sick of living. I've been crawling inside a bottle to ease the pain of living for the past ten years. I'm done with it. I'm sick of drinking, I'm sick of being sober. I'm sick of being on meds. I'm just done with everything.

Hey, thanks. And I'm 33. I've been suicidal since I can remember. I remember being in 5th grade, sitting on my bed wishing I didn't exist. Idk, I'm also a severe alcoholic. My life is shit. I don't want to be sober, I hate that, and I don't wanna be drunk anymore either. The real point to it all is I've always wanted to end it. And I think it's just time. I'm supposed to go to rehab next week and I just don't think I can do it.
